items.title: Technology and data raise the bar for high net worth insurance advice, says Hiscox
items.summary: Matthew Perkin of Hiscox told a London forum that digital tools and customer access to data increase rather than replace the need for specialist broker advice.

items.title: Precise triggers and exclusions dictate cat bond payouts in extreme tail-risk events
items.summary: Insurance Business UK reports that catastrophe bond payouts depend heavily on exact trigger definitions and exclusions when severe losses strike insured regions.

items.title: Over £400bn transferred from UK DB schemes to insurers for buy-ins
items.summary: LCP analysis shows that UK defined benefit pension schemes have transferred more than £400bn in assets to insurers over the past two decades.

items.title: Aon expands Pietro Toffanello’s leadership remit across Iberia, South Africa and Israel
items.summary: Aon has widened Pietro Toffanello's responsibilities to cover Iberia, sub-Saharan Africa and Israel alongside his ongoing leadership of Aon Reinsurance in Italy.

items.title: London market tech gap widens for brokers following Blueprint Two cancellation
items.summary: The collapse of Blueprint Two leaves London market insurers to modernise independently, magnifying operational divides for brokers.

items.title: MNK International appoints Danny Greenaway to lead new aviation and aerospace division
items.summary: MNK International has appointed industry veteran Danny Greenaway as Managing Director to oversee the launch of its new Aviation and Aerospace division in London.
